title.zh: v2.2.1 手机端换新配色：冷色深底 + 每模块一个强调色
title.en: v2.2.1 A New Phone Palette: Cool Dark Ground, One Accent Per Module

highlights.zh: **去掉了那套土黄。** 底色从暖棕改为冷调近黑（#0b0b14 / #14141f），文字改为中性白，强调色按模块区分：**首页 青绿 · 即兴 紫 · 挑战 玫瑰 · 探索 蓝 · 更多 灰**；顶部光晕换成「强调色 + 紫」双径向渐变。
highlights.en: **The muddy amber is gone.** The ground went from warm brown to a cool near-black (#0b0b14 / #14141f), the text is a neutral white, and the accent is per module: **home teal · jam violet · challenge rose · explore blue · more slate**, with a two-stop accent-plus-violet glow at the top.

highlights.zh: **改法刻意只动颜色，不动组件**：55 处引用本来就写在 `--m-gold*` token 上，所以换值即换整屏；模块多色用 `.mobile-root[data-module=…]` 覆盖。第一版把颜色值扫进了 Tailwind 的 arbitrary class 名和内联样式里，手机 E2E 立刻报运行时错误，已回滚并改成 token-only（这正是「只在 CSS 里换值」的原因）。
highlights.en: **Deliberately a colour-only change**: the 55 references already went through the `--m-gold*` tokens, so changing the values re-skins every screen, and the per-module hues are `[data-module]` overrides. The first attempt swept the new values into Tailwind arbitrary class names and inline styles; the phone E2E failed on a runtime error, so that was rolled back in favour of tokens only.

highlights.zh: **顺带定位了那个运行时错误的根因**：canvas 的颜色字符串**不能**用 CSS 变量，`addColorStop(rgb(var(--x)/0.14))` 在 WebKit 直接抛 `The string did not match the expected pattern`。现在唱片光晕在 resize 时把 `--m-gold` 解析成具体 rgb，再用它拼 rgba——所以画布也跟着模块配色走。
highlights.en: **And the root cause of that runtime error is now known**: canvas colour strings cannot contain CSS variables — `addColorStop(rgb(var(--x)/0.14))` throws `The string did not match the expected pattern` on WebKit. The disc's bloom now resolves `--m-gold` to concrete rgb on resize and builds rgba from it, so the canvas follows the module accent too.
